title: SCHC rule-set version is not bound to a concrete immutable registry
description: Python SchcContext accepts arbitrary/reserved versions with the current rules and compatibility tests/vectors treat equal arbitrary values as compatible even though no historical registries exist. Bind supported versions to concrete immutable registries, reject unsupported local versions, and add DIO join/filter enforcement tests.
notes: Security review adds operational enforcement: bind authenticated DIO version to peer/DODAG state; equality is a MUST for admission, absent/malformed/unsupported values fail closed, and mismatched peers permit only validated single-frame Rule 255 outside compressed/fragmented operation. Python/Rust option constructors distinguish parseable remote bytes from locally supported v3. Add end-to-end join/TX/RX gating tests.
